<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/build_docs.ts - do not edit by hand; run `bun run docs:build` -->

Generated from the launcher's detected tools plus the hand-kept rows in [features.json](features.json). Status vocabulary:

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Implemented and verified | The behaviour was run or covered by automated tests, and the *Verification* column says how and when. |
| Implemented but not verified | The code exists but nobody has run it for this documentation. |
| Partially implemented | Some of it works, or it is a placeholder/sample. |
| Planned | Does not exist yet; must not be described as available. |
| Unsupported | Known not to work or intentionally not supported. |
| Unknown | Not yet investigated. |
